description: This file contains database utility functions for a Python project using SQLAlchemy, including engine initialization, database connection management, pinging the database, and seeding a demo users table.

classes.name: Base
classes.description: Declarative base for ORM models to subclass.

methods.name: _normalize_database_url
methods.description: Normalizes the DATABASE_URL string, handling quoted URLs and 'psql' prefix.

methods.name: _ensure_engine
methods.description: Creates and returns a SQLAlchemy engine if not already initialized, handling URL normalization and error logging.

methods.name: _get_sessionmaker
methods.description: Returns the sessionmaker instance, initializing the engine if necessary.

methods.name: get_db
methods.description: Yields a SQLAlchemy session, raising an error if the engine is not initialized.

methods.name: ping_db
methods.description: Pings the database to check connectivity, with optional retries and exponential backoff.

methods.name: init_db
methods.description: Initializes the database connection and pings the database to verify connectivity.

methods.name: ensure_simple_users_table_and_seed
methods.description: Creates a demo_users table if it doesn't exist and seeds default users (Alice and Bob).
